correctness.rationale: The trace of the symmetric matrix exponential is strictly convex on all nonzero Laplacian-weight directions, forcing the unique unrestricted optimum and equal ordinary rates. The fixed-price growing-star and fixed-size large-price laws follow from explicit limits; the proof covers m>=3, B>0, r>1, t>0 and equality. value.rationale: The classification resolves a natural infinite-family finite-horizon resource design with an exact all-parameter support transition. The premium leaf is optimally disconnected early but strictly active after one horizon; this sharply contrasts the positive-spoke λ2-optimal design. The dimensionless activation law converges to log(price), a quantitatively meaningful, nontrivial network-size scaling. Neither a generic convex-program formulation nor a numerical instance gives this sharp physical design rule.
